verdict.rationale: Apify's SDK documents SessionPool, which manages cookie and session persistence alongside proxy rotation, giving developers a mechanism to reuse login/session state across requests (apify-docs-31). However, there is no dedicated documentation on persisting full browser profiles (e.g., storage state files, saved browser contexts) across separate Actor runs, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit browser-profile/storageState persistence docs across runs, cross-run profile reuse examples, independent corroboration.
